Thanks for the update — helpful. Short checklist below (these are our must-haves for an infra/SSO technical run):

1) Countersigned mutual NDA (we have a signed copy as soon as legal completes).
2) Vendor intake completed in your portal (so we can provision a scoped test tenant).
3) A service account (or temporary SAML test user) with admin read-only privileges for SSO validation.
4) Network allowlist for our test host IPs (I'll share the small CIDR list separately).

If procurement can confirm items 1 and 2 by 4/28 morning we can still do a shortened session on 4/28 focused on architecture and non-SSO flows; otherwise I recommend we move the full technical run to Tue, May 5 (10:00–11:30 PT) so the intake backlog clears and you have time to provision the test user.
